title: The Three Malformations Stripped, Poured Down, and Purified
description: A three-stage purification of the malformations. T44 describes the proprium's three settled dwellings — natural truths salted, understanding gone dark, love burning self-consumingly — addressed by the Lord through three garments (thought, truth-in-natural-degree, rightly-ordered love) like a wise physician giving each medicine in its proper season. T45 describes the threefold purification by descent and answering ascent: pure truth descending and meeting disordered natural truth, pure light meeting darkness, love descending and meeting the fire of self-love — what cannot be conjoined driven out beyond the cosmos. T46 traces the Living Spirit's purification through three formative acts: cycles set in motion, the dragon-Error cast down, the zodiacal sphere fashioned to perform winnowing, restraining, and gathering inward.
